fieldValues.title: Affirmation is pass-through: 324 of 334 affirmation acts are byte-identical to the suggestion; all 142 problems went untouched
fieldValues.summary: Measured 2026-11-03 over the Affirmed container: of 334 affirmed records with a derived-from link to a suggestion of the same type, 324 (97%) are identical in every field and 10 (3%) were changed. Problems 142 of 142 identical, clusters 24 of 24, poles 16 of 16, axes 9 of 9, personas 5 of 5. The 10 edits are real judgement: rewritten tension descriptions, filled principle boundary clauses, doubled remedy moves. In the Collaborative writing walk (#89): 5 of 58 acts edited. Affirmation-round commits carry no reasons.
evidence: python3 field-by-field diff of each Affirmed record against its derived-from suggestion, ids, timestamps, createdBy and codes ignored; containers 5e28aa7e (343) and 219dc999 (589), Set aside 17006e00 (4)

fieldValues.body: This is the evidence exercise 179676eb asked for: which acts carry judgement and which are bookkeeping. The judgement concentrates in tensions, principles, remedies and the domain record (10 edits, 9 of them in those types); problems, clusters, poles, axes and personas were never changed by an affirmation. The per-record act on those types is bookkeeping and can be carried by derivation from one affirmed story (option "affirm the walk") or by a chartered group, under the decided rule that confidence grades care and does not gate (9d50126b). Counter-evidence to keep in view: the owner may read a record and pass it because it is right, which this measure cannot see; set-asides (4) are the other visible judgement.
